    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen, objects = set(), []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            points = set()
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                points.add((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    q = (y + dy, x + dx)
                    if (0 <= q[0] < h and 0 <= q[1] < w and q not in seen
                            and grid[q[0]][q[1]] == color):
                        seen.add(q)
                        stack.append(q)
            r0, r1 = min(y for y, x in points), max(y for y, x in points)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y, x in points), max(x for y, x in points)
            empty = {(y, x) for y in range(r0, r1 + 1)
                     for x in range(c0, c1 + 1)} - points
            frontier = [(y, x) for y, x in empty
                        if y in (r0, r1) or x in (c0, c1)]
            exterior = set(frontier)
            while frontier:
                y, x = frontier.pop()
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    q = (y + dy, x + dx)
                    if q in empty and q not in exterior:
                        exterior.add(q)
                        frontier.append(q)
            objects.append([color, points, bool(empty - exterior)])

    placed = []
    for enclosed, direction in ((True, -1), (False, 1)):
        group = [obj for obj in objects if obj[2] == enclosed]
        group.sort(key=lambda obj: min(y for y, x in obj[1]) if direction < 0
                   else -max(y for y, x in obj[1]))
        for color, points, _ in group:
            while True:
                shifted = {(y + direction, x) for y, x in points}
                if (min(y for y, x in shifted) < 0 or max(y for y, x in shifted) >= h
                        or any(shifted & old for _, old in placed)):
                    break
                points = shifted
            placed.append((color, points))

    output = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for color, points in placed:
        for y, x in points:
